_doc: Best-of-N seeds for ltx_a2v_artic talking shots of rebuilt characters (opensoul.lipsync.best_of_config, docs/LIPSYNC_SCORER.md). Calibrated on 74 takes (lip-sync G3, eye ruling 19 Oct). 'fields' maps each metric to the key in the external scorer's JSON result. Rejects: |offset| >= abs_offset_min, open_frac <= open_frac_max, grin v2: grin_frac > grin_frac_max or grin_win_max > grin_win_max (MediaPipe mouthSmile blendshape, highest mean over any 0.5 s window). Eyes never reject: eyes_open_frac only breaks ties among passing ltx_av seeds within tiebreak.eyes_open_frac_lse_c_window of the best LSE-C (a seed with eyes_shut_flag loses ties to an unflagged one), eyes_shut_flag is a needs_review reason (never the LatentSync fallback), and a start-frame eyeBlink >= start_frame.eye_blink_warn is a warning. Lines in grin_review_only (line id: explicit line field, else lNN in the take/shot name, else in the wav name) get grin as a review flag instead of a reject. Env overrides: see docs/LIPSYNC_SCORER.md. 'recipe' picks how a talking shot of a rebuilt character is made: 'L1c' (default, the 'l1c' block: base gated on look + camera lock, then the LatentSync mouth pass) or 'best_of_fallback' (the older pick: highest LSE-C, LatentSync only when every seed is rejected). Env OPENSOUL_LIPSYNC_RECIPE overrides.

eyes_shut._doc: Review flag, never a reject (provisional). A face frame is shut when mean(eyeBlinkLeft, eyeBlinkRight) >= eye_blink_min AND mean(eyeLookDownLeft, eyeLookDownRight) < look_down_max; eyes_shut_max_s = the longest continuous run of shut face frames (a frame without a face breaks it); eyes_shut_flag = that run > min_duration_s. The scorer's eyes_shut_flag / eyes_shut_max_s are used when present; per-frame series (fields.eye_blink_frames, eye_look_down_frames, fps) are the fallback.

start_frame._doc: Warning only, never a reject: start-frame mean eyeBlink >= eye_blink_warn -> 'Eyes look closed in the start frame'.

eyeline._doc: Warn only, provisional (never a reject, a review reason or a fallback). Look score = how much the eyes look at the listener (1) rather than drift to the lens (0): the scorer's start_eye_look_listener / end_eye_look_listener, else the mean of fields.eye_look_listener_frames over the first / last window_s (one frame without fps; frames without a face left out). Warn 'eyeline drifts to lens at end' when the end is below end_warn or falls by drop_warn or more from the start (0.68 -> 0.19 warns). The scorer's eyeline_drift_warn (bool), when present, decides the warning instead (scorer wins); its per-frame values may be 1/0 (look >= 0.3 or not) with null for no face, and the group is omitted when the shot has no listener. No data -> skipped.

l1c.summary: grin-gated + camera-locked a2v base (eyes open, looking at the listener) → LatentSync, MediaPipe only
l1c._doc: L1c, two stages for talking shots (docs/LIPSYNC_SCORER.md). Stage 1 (base): a2v best-of-N gated on look only: base_reject rules (grin_frac, grin_win_max, open_frac; never offset or lse_c), eyes_shut_flag a review flag; passing bases ranked by base_rank (an eyes_shut_flag base ranks after unflagged ones). The talk prompt keeps the eyes open and on the listener in the scene (the camera only when the shot has no listener). Stage 2 (mouth): LatentSync 1.6 through the OpenSoul wrapper with the MediaPipe face detector only. The output is scored with output_reject; a grin in the output means the base was wrong, so the next passing base is used (LatentSync is never re-run with other settings). The base is trimmed to the voice length, never looped; a base shorter than the voice is flagged base_short. Stage 2 runs by default for rebuilt characters (stage2.default_on_rebuilt, whatever the voice id) and for the voices in stage2.default_on_voices (with their stage2.voice_aliases); otherwise it is skipped when the stage-1 pick already passes every output_reject rule. The inner-mouth pass is optional (experimental, off by default). Framing and cost are hints only.

voice_aliases._doc: Other ids for the same voice (case-insensitive): a shot whose voice id is an alias counts as its canonical voice for default_on_voices; records keep the id as given and add voice_canonical.

inner_mouth._doc: Optional, experimental, off by default (setting OPENSOUL_L1C_INNER_MOUTH=on). It can leave black voids in the mouth and hold the mouth open into a pause. When on it runs with no flags: the runner's own defaults are L1c2 (Config in ls_inner_mouth.py: lip_color_fix on, lip_fix_mode blend, mask_erode 1.0, open_thr 0.06, dilate 1, face_style auto).

framing._doc: Warning only, talk shots: start-frame face height over face_h_frac_warn of the frame height, or |yaw| over abs_yaw_warn. Runs only when the data is there (the shot's face_box, or the scorer's start_face_h_frac / start_yaw).

cost._doc: LatentSync runs in 16-frame chunks; about 35.3 s per chunk measured on a DGX Spark. Estimate = ceil(frames / 16) * 35.3 s.

cam._doc: Camera-creep gate: after a2v and again after LatentSync. REJECT when max |scale-1| > scale_drift_max_pct OR max centre translation > trans_max_px. A stage-1 fail re-seeds (never LatentSync); a post-LS fail re-picks the next base like a grin. Env OPENSOUL_A2V_CAMLOCK=off disables the AddGuide graph wiring and this gate.
